title: Negating a function negates its coefficient sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. The sum of the singleton Fourier coefficients of the pointwise negative of $f$ is the negative of the corresponding sum for $f$.
